keys_page.stored_in_the_vault_sealed: Stored in the vault, sealed like the key, so connections never ask for it.
keys_page.the_file_s_content_is: The file's content is copied into the vault; the file itself is not needed afterwards.
notifications_settings.alert_my_phone_wh: Alert my phone when an agent is waiting
notifications_settings.approvals_are_una: Approvals are unaffected: the window opened and waited as usual.
notifications_settings.fix_the_server_ad: Fix the server address to get the code
notifications_settings.how_long_waits: How long a program waits for your answer in an approval window, and for you to unlock the vault when it finds it locked. Then it gets {timeout} or {locked}.
notifications_settings.if_you_turn_this_: If you turn this on, an alert only ever says “An agent is waiting for your approval” or “Flint is locked and an agent is waiting”: no host, user, command, program, vault or count. It can't approve anything; you still answer at this computer.
notifications_settings.in_ntfy_tap_stron: In ntfy, tap {strong} and subscribe to the topic above. The code opens the topic's web page, which shows alerts too while it is open.
notifications_settings.install_strong_fr: Install {strong} from Google Play or F-Droid.
notifications_settings.no_code_until_the: No code until the server address is valid
notifications_settings.ntfy_sh_or_the_ad: ntfy.sh, or the address of your own ntfy server.
notifications_settings.on_your_phone_is_: On: your phone is told when an agent is waiting.
notifications_settings.over_http_the_top: Over http:// the topic travels unencrypted. Anyone who reads it could send alerts to your phone, but never read yours.
notifications_settings.random_and_belong: Random, and belongs to this computer. It isn't synced with the vault.
notifications_settings.scan_the_code_wit: Scan the code with the camera: ntfy opens and subscribes to the topic.
notifications_settings.that_s_all_an_ale: That's all an alert ever says. It never approves, denies or unlocks anything: you still answer at this computer.
notifications_settings.the_program_must_: The program must be able to wait 30 minutes for an answer. An agent can run {span} in the background so its own timeout doesn't cut it off first.
notifications_settings.with_alerts_a_wai: With alerts, a wait of {ALERT_WAIT_MIN} min or more gives you time to see the alert and come back. It's {approval_wait} min now.
notifications_settings.your_phone_stops_: Your phone stops getting alerts until you subscribe to the new topic.
password_field.password_copied_the_clipb: Password copied · the clipboard clears in 30 s
relaunch_confirm.flint_version_opens_rig: Flint {version} opens right after. Not now? Relaunch stays in the status bar and in About.
remember_option.the_vault_key_goes_into: The vault key goes into {keychain}, so Flint, the {span} CLI and the agents you approve open this vault without the master password. Anyone using this computer while it is unlocked can open Flint too.
server_stats_item.server_resources_first: Server resources, first sample on its way
settings_page.always_the_classic_bitmap_: Always the classic bitmap updates, as earlier versions of Flint used: lossless, several times the bandwidth. Try it too if a desktop shows wrong colours or garbled areas.
settings_page.always_the_graphics_pipeli: Always the graphics pipeline, with the best codec both ends support (H.264 where this computer decodes it): the least bandwidth. A server without it gets the classic updates.
settings_page.an_image_pasted_into_a: An image pasted into a session is uploaded to the server and its path is pasted, for a program there such as Claude Code. Larger files go through Files. Set on this computer.
settings_page.both_themes_come_from_the: Both themes come from the same tokens.
settings_page.bottom_corners_sit_above_t: Bottom corners sit above the status bar; top corners under the tab bar. Never over the rail.
settings_page.check_every.0: Only on changes and at unlock
settings_page.chosen_when_the_tab_connec: Chosen when the tab connects: lossless bitmaps on a local network, where they feel smoothest, and the graphics pipeline over a VPN or the internet, where it needs far less bandwidth.
settings_page.clears_the_vault_key_from: Clears the vault key from memory. Open sessions keep running behind the lock screen; the flint CLI and new sessions wait until you unlock with the master password.
settings_page.cpu_memory_network_disk_an: CPU, memory, network, disk and uptime of the host the active tab is on.
settings_page.ctrl_c_copies_only_while: Ctrl+C copies only while text is selected
settings_page.disconnect_this_vault_from: Disconnect this vault from its server?
settings_page.each_key_as_set_below: Each key as set below. Choose Mac or Windows to go back to a preset.
settings_page.fetches_a_small_signed_fil: Fetches a small signed file from GitHub at launch and every hour. Nothing about you or this computer is sent.
settings_page.focus_active_tab_primary_b: Focus, active tab, primary buttons, cursor.
settings_page.forget_the_key_on_this: Forget the key on this device?
settings_page.how_a_new_remote_desktop: How a new remote desktop tab is sent to this computer. Each tab can switch from its toolbar while connected.
settings_page.is_a_build_made_between: ) is a build made between two releases.
settings_page.keep_this_vault_in_step: Keep this vault in step across your machines through a server you run. The server stores the encrypted file, never the key.
settings_page.keys_where_a_pc_keyboard: Keys where a PC keyboard has them: {span} and {span2} copy and paste; {span3} is the Windows key.
settings_page.left_and_right_keys_apart: Left and right keys apart. Off sends nothing.
settings_page.linux_keys_note: On Linux {cmd} becomes {ctrlShift} and {shiftCmd} becomes {ctrlAltShift}, so plain Ctrl combos always reach the terminal (Kitty keyboard protocol). Custom shortcuts are coming in a later version.
settings_page.monospaced_fonts_installed: Monospaced fonts installed on this machine. Nerd Font builds show prompt glyphs.
settings_page.name: Name
settings_page.no_flint_command: This build carries no flint command. A build from source puts one on the PATH with {script}.
settings_page.none_yet_a_server_s: None yet: a server's key is recorded the first time you trust it.
settings_page.opens_the_vault_and_seals: Opens the vault and seals its saved passwords and keys. Changing it re-encrypts the vault; the CLI's flint vault passwd does the same.
settings_page.rdp_mac_note: Flint's own shortcuts stay on {cmd} in an RDP tab: the command palette and {digits}. Combinations macOS keeps for itself, such as {tab} and {space}, never reach Windows.
settings_page.reads_cpu_memory_and_netwo: Reads CPU, memory and network over the tab's own SSH session. Servers that log every command (auditd) will log these reads.
settings_page.reopen_the_last_vault_on: Reopen the last vault on launch
settings_page.row_height_in_the_host: Row height in the host tree, tabs and lists.
settings_page.server_keys_this_vault_tru: Server keys this vault trusts. Shared with the Flint CLI.
settings_page.shown_in_the_vault_switche: Shown in the vault switcher and used by flint --vault. The file keeps its name.
settings_page.span_and_span2_copy_and: {span} and {span2} copy and paste in Windows, as on a Mac; {span3} is the Windows key.
settings_page.the_app_and_the_flint: The app and the flint command update together. A release is checked against Flint's signature before Flint offers it.
settings_page.the_download_of_version_di: The download of {version} didn't pass verification and was discarded. Nothing was installed.

settings_page.the_flint_command_runs_thi: The flint command runs this copy of Flint through a link in a folder on your PATH, so updating Flint updates it too.
settings_page.the_server_stores_the_encr: The server stores the encrypted file, its version and id, and the label it was given, if any. Never the key.
settings_page.the_terminal_s_palette_in: The terminal's palette, in its {p} variant: it follows the app's theme.
settings_page.the_version_this_build_of: The version this build of Flint was made from.
